    Long induced paths in critical forms #

    An induced path of full edges of length m (LongPath q m) is a sequence of m distinct points with coefficient -1 between neighbours and 0 between non-neighbours.

    For a graph form with a positive radical vector (Rad1): a nonempty set closed under neighbours is everything (Rad1.closed_eq_univ), and a nonzero u ≥ 0 with q(u) ≤ 0 is sincere (Rad1.pos_of_nonpos). If the graph has a cycle, it is a single cycle Ã and has an induced path through all points but one (Rad1.longPath_of_core).
